title: Marine Weather Window for Passage
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marineweather:forecast
| eval good=if(wind_kt<20 AND wave_m<1.5 AND gust_kt<25,1,0)
| where good=1 AND forecast_epoch>now()
| sort forecast_epoch
| table forecast_epoch wind_kt wave_m
description: Finds the upcoming windows of calm-enough wind and sea state for a safe passage or day out.
value: Choosing the right weather window is the core of safe boating; an automated finder removes guesswork from planning.
implementation: Ingest marine forecasts into `index=personal`; surface upcoming safe windows.
visualization: Table of upcoming safe weather windows.
grandmaExplanation: It finds the upcoming calm windows in the marine forecast that are safe for a trip out.
